candidates.reason: Contains the only test that asserts a dependency DeprecationWarning is NOT raised ("Attempting to mutate a Context after a Connection was created") and selects behavior through scrapy.utils._deps_compat gates (PYOPENSSL_SET_CIPHER_LIST_TMP_CONN, TWISTED_TLS_NEW_IMPL). The VCS workflow installs pyOpenSSL/Twisted from git, so this is the primary place where VCS-only warnings surface.

Shared download-handler test base whose expectations are branched on dependency versions (PYOPENSSL_X509_DEPRECATED, TWISTED_TLS_LIMITS_OFFBY1); it is the behavior/warning surface exercised by every HTTP download handler under newer VCS dependency versions.

Builds TLS server contexts with pyOpenSSL APIs (load_certificate/load_privatekey, X509 handling) that are deprecated in development pyOpenSSL releases and are gated by PYOPENSSL_X509_DEPRECATED, so it is a likely source of the warnings the VCS workflow reports.

Gated on STDLIB_IMPROVED_ROBOTFILEPARSER, i.e. it encodes expected behavior differences of the Python 3.14 stdlib used by the VCS workflow, and exercises the same parser code paths that emit version-dependent warnings.

Uses runtime parsel version detection (PARSEL_VERSION/PARSEL_18_PLUS) to skip or assert based on the installed parsel build; the VCS workflow resolves parsel from git, so these tests are the ones that shift when dependency warnings/behavior change.

Branches on sys.version_info and interpreter implementation (Python 3.13/3.14, PyPy) to assert behavior that differs across the interpreter used by the VCS workflow, and is co-located with the annotation-warning workarounds.

Asserts warning emission (ScrapyDeprecationWarning) and has a Python-3.14-only variant for lazily evaluated annotations, so it is directly sensitive to interpreter-driven warning behavior in the VCS environment.

Uses a module-level pytest.mark.filterwarnings to silence the import-time deprecation warning from scrapy.mail; it is the canonical example of the warning-suppression pattern that changes when import-time warnings are addressed.

Wraps imports of deprecated modules (scrapy.extensions.statsmailer, scrapy.mail) in warnings.catch_warnings filters and would need updating if the deprecation warnings these modules emit are reworked.

Covers scrapy.utils.reactor, which contains explicit catch_warnings/filterwarnings handling for asyncio deprecations (get_event_loop, get_event_loop_policy); changes to warning handling in that module are validated here.

Exercises the httpx2 download handler that the VCS workflow installs from a development branch, including a test explicitly about warning output; development httpx2 builds are a likely origin of VCS-only warnings.
